ayahs.tr: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

ayahs.ar: وَرَاَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ فِيْ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًا ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًا ۝٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
